notes.title: Steam Next Fest Broadcast
notes.notes:
This is an action-adventure game that requires you to use your brain. 
Save the world with your powers of observation and inspiration!

In this broadcast, a pre-recorded play video is played repeatedly. 
You can see the story up to the point where the protagonist defeats the first boss.
Feel free to ask if you have any questions.
 
I am Japanese. 
I don't speak English, but I can read and write a little, so I reply by chat. 
It may take a long time to respond.

notes.title: The playtest of the action-adventure game "ONENELLEMOO" is underway.
notes.notes:
[h1] The playtest of ONENELLEMOO is underway. [/h1]
I would be very happy if you could write your impressions of playing this game on the online bulletin board.
It would be very helpful if you could write how you felt about the difficulty.
If you find a bug, please report it.

[h2] Playtest Volume [/h2]
On Playtest, you can play about 2/3 of the upcoming Chapter 1.

[h2] Supported OS [/h2]
Windows and Mac
